title: 第3章  我在屋里干活，你却在外面送死？
slug: 长生让你延续香火没让你量产仙帝
content_zh:
江翠萍呆呆地点头，便没有再问为什么。
作为女人。
有些事情要学会闭嘴。
“恭喜仙师。”
“我说过了，不用叫我仙师。”
“好的。长生。”
江翠萍咬着嘴唇，点了点头。
然后有些慌乱地转身去灶台忙活了。
很明显。
她还没有习惯跟李长生相处。
李长生看着少女忙碌的背影，收敛了笑意，走到铜境前。
只见镜中人，剑眉星目，双眸炯炯有神，身体上的老人斑都少了不少。
看起来年轻了不止十岁。
身体机能重塑真是个好东西啊！
李长生喃喃一声。
随后好像想到了什么，眉头皱得深深的。
“麻烦了。”
“这里可是青云宗脚下的安置区。”
“周围的道友都认识我。”
“如果顶住这幅模样出去，恐怕会出事。”

李长生沉思了片刻。
心念一动。
使用系统奖励的技能。
下一秒。
外貌身形迅速产生变化，就像被捏脸一样。
目之所及之处，镜子里英姿勃发的男子，脊背佝偻了下来。
红润的皮肤重新变得松弛，布满了岁月的沟壑。
身姿也透出一股行将就木的暮气。
就连修为也隐藏了起来。
在短短三个呼吸间。
李长生又变回了那个【耳顺之年】的落魄老头。
唯一的区别，就是这个老头的眼睛很亮很亮。
“这就是系统的伪装术和龟息术吗？”
“非常不错。”
“有了这两项技能计不用担心被发现了。”
李长生喃喃一声。
片刻后。
江翠萍端着热腾腾的早饭走了进来。
“长生，吃饭了。”
刚抬头，看到李长生的模样，又是一愣，手中的碗差点都没端稳。

“长生，怎么……”
李长生一脸淡定，走到桌边坐下，接过碗筷，笑了笑：
“翠萍，糟老头子，明白了吗？”
江翠萍身子一颤。
虽然她没读过书，但在深宅大院里当过丫鬟，最懂察言观色，自然明白什么叫祸从口出。
夫君这是在藏拙！
“翠萍明白了。”
江翠萍低下头回答。
李长生满意地点点头。
随后好像想到了什么，连忙从口袋中拿出一颗气血丹，放在江翠萍面前。
“这是我用剩下的丹药。”
“能够调理身体，增长血气。”
“给你调养身体。”
气血丹是系统奖励的。
李长生的资质，即便用了也没有效果，还不如给自己的婆娘使用。
养好自己婆娘的身体。
晚上也能玩得快乐一些。
“使不得。”
“长生，你自己用吧！我就是一个妇人，给我的话，太浪费了。”江翠萍看着眼前的丹药，有些动容，很感动。
李长生声音不容置疑：

“给你，你就吃。”
“如果你真的想感谢我，就给我多生几个孩子。”
江翠萍闻言，不再推迟，一把接过丹药，一口吃进去。
丹药入口即化，暖流涌进体内，力气和体力都在不断增长。
片刻之后。
江翠萍感觉到自己身体素质大概增长了一倍左右。
并且还在持续增长中。
如果晚上跟李长生多子多福的话，应该能顶得住几个小时的快乐。
江翠萍很感动，看向李长生的目光，变得温柔了很多。
旋即发自内心改了口。
“谢夫君！”
李长生坦然受之。
“不用客气。”
“咱们李家还得靠你开枝散叶呢。”
提到这个，江翠萍的脸【刷】地一下红到了耳根，埋头喝粥，不敢吭声，只是扒饭的速度慢了下来，嘴角泛起一丝浅浅的甜意。
吃过早饭。
李长生没有急着修炼。
有了系统。
苦修这种笨办法已经不是首选了。
当务之急，是如何把这个【家】经营起来。

正想着，门外突然传来一阵嘈杂的脚步声，紧接着是粗鲁的拍门声。
“李长生。”
“快开门。”
“咱们一起去喝一杯吧。”
李长生认出了这声音，这是昨天炫耀老婆的王麻子。
随后冲着正在院子里的江翠萍招了招手，示意其躲进屋里别出来。
这才走到大门口。
门外站着五六个老头，都是昨天一起被遣散的外门弟子。
他们个个红光满面，身边还搂着各自挑选的【娇妻】。
尤其是王麻子，搂着肤白貌美的锦衣女子。
该锦衣女子正一脸强颜欢笑地帮其捏背捶肩。
李长生，剧烈地咳嗽了两声，身子佝偻得更厉害了，摆了摆手，声音有些虚弱：
“老王啊，我就不去了。”
“昨晚折腾得太晚，腰闪了，现在腿还打颤呢。家里那婆娘也粗笨，上不得台面，就不去给各位丢人现眼了。你们去玩好，玩好……”
听到这话，王麻子等人，互相对视一眼，哄堂大笑。
“哈哈哈哈。长生啊长生，你这也太虚了吧？才一晚上就不行了？”
王麻子笑得眼泪都快流出来了，眼中满满的优越感。
李长生竟然一晚上就虚了，够废物的，不值得让自己多关注。
“行吧。”
“那我们就去喝酒了。”

“到时候你可别说我们不叫你。”
王麻子大手一挥，搂着美人，带着一群老头浩浩荡荡地走了。
李长生站在门口，依旧是一副讨好的苦笑模样，目送着他们离开。直到他们的身影完全消失在眼前。
脸上的笑容瞬间消失。
腰杆挺直了几分。
“真是蠢货啊。”
“死到临头还不自知。”
“难道你们不知道女人越漂亮越危险吗？”
李长生在心里吐槽一声。
只因他刚才在王麻子身上闻到了一股极淡的血腥气。
准确一点来说，不是王麻子身上的，而是王麻子怀里的女人的。
那女人，有问题。
李长生也没有多管闲事，免得惹火上身。旋即回到床榻之侧，目光火热地看着江翠萍。
此刻江翠萍已经换成一套白色的连衣裙了。
圆润的大白腿上套着肉丝。
五官精致。
越看越耐看。
好像江翠萍也很好看啊！
“夫君，你怎么这样看着人家？”江翠萍含羞问。
“哈哈……”

“来……”
“咱们研究一下家族兴旺大计。”李长生坏笑一声。
content_en:
Jiang Cuiping nodded blankly and did not ask why.
As a woman.
There are some things you have to learn to shut up about.
"Congratulations, Immortal Master."
"I told you, you don't need to call me Immortal Master."
"Okay. Immortality."
Jiang Cuiping bit her lip and nodded.
Then he turned around in a panic and went to work on the stove.
It's obvious.
She wasn't used to getting along with Li Changsheng yet.
Li Changsheng looked at the girl's busy back, suppressed his smile, and walked to the front of the copper realm.
I saw the person in the mirror, with piercing eyebrows and starry eyes, and the age spots on his body were reduced a lot.
He looks more than ten years younger.
Reshaping body functions is such a good thing!
Li Changsheng murmured.
Then he seemed to think of something, and his brows furrowed deeply.
"Trouble."
"This is the resettlement area at the foot of Qingyun Sect."
"Everyone around me knows me."
"If you go out with this appearance, I'm afraid something will happen."
Li Changsheng thought for a moment.
A thought came to my mind.
Use the skills rewarded by the system.
The next second.
His appearance and body shape changed rapidly, as if his face had been pinched.
Wherever he looked, the handsome man in the mirror had his back hunched.
The rosy skin became saggy again, covered with the ravines of time.
His figure also gave off a sense of dying.
Even the cultivation level is hidden.
In just three breaths.
Li Changsheng has turned back into the down-and-out old man who was in the age of hearing.
The only difference is that the old man's eyes are very bright.
"Is this the systematic camouflage technique and turtle breath technique?"
“Very nice.”
"With these two skills, you don't have to worry about being discovered."
Li Changsheng murmured.
After a while.
Jiang Cuiping walked in with a hot breakfast.
"Changsheng, it's time to eat."
Just when I looked up, I was stunned again when I saw Li Changsheng's appearance, and I almost couldn't hold the bowl in my hand steady.
"Changsheng, why..."
Li Changsheng looked calm, walked to the table, sat down, took the bowls and chopsticks, and smiled:
"Cuiping, you old man, do you understand?"
Jiang Cuiping trembled.
Although she has never read a book, she has worked as a maid in a deep house and knows how to observe words and emotions, so she naturally understands what it means to have trouble come from the mouth.
Husband, you are hiding your clumsiness!
"Cuiping understands."
Jiang Cuiping lowered her head and answered.
Li Changsheng nodded with satisfaction.
Then he seemed to think of something and quickly took out a Qi and Blood Pill from his pocket and placed it in front of Jiang Cuiping.
"This is the remaining elixir I used."
"It can regulate the body and increase blood energy."
"Take care of your body."
Qi and Blood Pills are rewarded by the system.
Even if Li Changsheng's qualifications were used, they would have no effect. He might as well use them on his own mother-in-law.
Take good care of your mother-in-law's body.
You can also have more fun at night.
"Can't do it."
"Immortality, use it yourself! I am just a woman, it would be a waste if you give it to me." Jiang Cuiping looked at the elixir in front of her, a little moved, and very touched.
Li Changsheng’s voice was unmistakable:
"Here you go, eat it."
"If you really want to thank me, give me more children."
Hearing this, Jiang Cuiping took the elixir without delay and took it in one gulp.
The elixir melts in your mouth, warmth surges into your body, and your strength and stamina continue to grow.
After a while.
Jiang Cuiping felt that her physical fitness had roughly doubled.
And it continues to grow.
If I have many children and many blessings with Li Changsheng at night, I should be able to withstand a few hours of happiness.
Jiang Cuiping was very moved, and the look she looked at Li Changsheng became much gentler.
He immediately changed his mind from the bottom of his heart.
"Thank you husband!"
Li Changsheng accepted it calmly.
"You're welcome."
"Our Li family still has to rely on you to spread its branches and leaves."
Mentioning this, Jiang Cuiping's face suddenly turned red to the roots of her ears. She buried her head in her porridge, not daring to say a word, and just picked up the rice as fast as she could.Slowing down, a hint of sweetness appeared at the corner of his mouth.
Had breakfast.
Li Changsheng was not in a hurry to practice.
There is a system.
The stupid method of penance is no longer the first choice.
The top priority is how to run this [home].
Just as he was thinking about it, there was suddenly a burst of noisy footsteps outside the door, followed by a rude knock on the door.
"Li Changsheng."
"Open the door quickly."
"Let's go have a drink together."
Li Changsheng recognized this voice. It was Wang Mazi who showed off his wife yesterday.
Then he waved to Jiang Cuiping who was in the yard, telling her to hide in the house and not come out.
Only then did he reach the gate.
There were five or six old men standing outside the door, all outer disciples who were dismissed together yesterday.
Their faces were all glowing, and they had their chosen wives beside them.
Especially Wang Mazi, who was holding the fair-skinned and beautiful woman in brocade.
The woman in brocade clothes was helping him squeeze his back and shoulders with a forced smile on his face.
Li Changsheng coughed twice violently, his body became more stooped, and he waved his hands, his voice a little weak:
"Old Wang, I won't go."
"I worked too late last night, my waist hurt, and my legs are still shaking now. The woman at home is also clumsy and can't stand on the stage, so I won't embarrass everyone. You go and have fun, have fun..."
Upon hearing this, Wang Mazi and others looked at each other and burst into laughter.
"Hahahahaha. Changsheng, Changsheng, are you too weak? You can't do it after just one night?"
Wang Mazi laughed so hard that tears almost flowed out, his eyes full of superiority.
Li Changsheng actually became weak in one night. He was a waste and not worthy of his attention.
"Okay."
"Then we're going to drink."
"Don't say we won't call you then."
Wang Mazi waved his hand, hugged the beauty, and walked away with a group of old men.
Li Changsheng stood at the door, still wearing a flattering wry smile, watching them leave. Until their figures completely disappeared from sight.
The smile on his face disappeared instantly.
The waist straightened a bit.
"What an idiot."
“You don’t even know you’re about to die.”
"Don't you know that the more beautiful a woman is, the more dangerous she is?"
Li Changsheng complained in his heart.
Just because he smelled a very faint smell of blood on Wang Mazi just now.
To be more precise, it was not from Wang Mazi's body, but from the woman in Wang Mazi's arms.
That woman has a problem.
Li Changsheng didn't meddle in other people's business, so as not to get angry. He immediately returned to the side of the bed and looked at Jiang Cuiping with fiery eyes.
At this moment Jiang Cuiping had changed into a white dress.
The round white legs are covered with shredded meat.
Exquisite facial features.
The more you look at it, the more interesting it becomes.
It seems that Jiang Cuiping is also very good-looking!
"Husband, why are you looking at me like this?" Jiang Cuiping asked shyly.
"Haha..."
"Come..."
"Let's study the family prosperity plan." Li Changsheng gave a wicked smile.
